claim: There is no primary-source evidence that Denuvo was removed from the Steam version; the Steam store page still declares 'Denuvo Antitamper' on 2026-10-23, so the 'removed later' claim is contradicted by available sources.
evidence: Steam store: 'Incorporates 3rd-party DRM: Denuvo Antitamper'; PCGW: Steam version requires Denuvo.
game_build_compatibility: Store notice is not tied to a build; coop-anything (third party) reports SteamStub present and a Denuvo-like section layout on build 3095001.
verification_method: Fetched store page; read PCGW wikitext; removal claims appear only in forum comments. Verify on our build statically: PE section names/sizes/entropy of a copied exe (no execution, no patching).
limitations: Store DRM notices are sometimes not updated after removal; only a binary inspection of our build can settle presence. We must not bypass or strip DRM.
next_experiment: Static PE inspection of a copied ShadowOfWar.exe (sections, entropy, .bind SteamStub section) and record findings in the anti-tamper evidence.
